plain: It moves across the sky: about 0.27 arcseconds per year, measured over 13 years (a very confident measurement), matching the catalog proper motion.
Its infrared colour W1-W2 = at least 1.4 mag is red, as for early-T and the reddest L brown dwarfs.
Its infrared brightness stays constant within the measurement errors.
Its SPHEREx spectrum fits a sdT4 brown-dwarf template best; the next best (sdM9.5) fits clearly worse.
